shortDescription: The Pentagon is in talks to lend roughly $5 billion to AI cloud-computing startup Fluidstack to shore up the U.S. data-center supply chain, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
